newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$300 mln in fund.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$300 mln in fund.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank injected T$300 million worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations on Friday, a central bank official said.
The bank executed a repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit, treasury bills and government bonds offered by interested financial institutions with a rate of 7.15 percent.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the NCDs, treasury bills and government bonds within 10 days, the official said.
The central bank's repeated fund injections have effectively eased banking system's liquidity squeeze.

At 0400 GMT, the overnight interbank rate eased to 7.795 percent against Thursday's 8.240 close -- significantly lower than early this week's almost double-digit level but still above the central bank's previously declared 5.0-5.5 percent target zone.
